name: measure-optimize-verify
summary: For performance work. Measure first, change the algorithm, then prove that the output did not change.

roles.name: profiler
roles.job: Measures the current speed and finds the slow part.

roles.name: optimizer
roles.job: Changes the slow part. Prefers a better algorithm over small tricks.

roles.name: verifier
roles.job: Compares the new output with the old output on many random inputs. Measures again.

steps.do: Measure the time at several input sizes. Find the slow part and its complexity.
Rewrite the slow part. Keep the public interface.
Keep a copy of the old code for comparison. Compare outputs on many random inputs, including ties and edge cases. Measure again and add the numbers.

rules: Output must be exactly the same as before, including order.
Write all timings with their input sizes.
